lunch_start.name: {name}
lunch_start.text: *Lunchtime. The hallway is packed with students. A rooftop lunchbox, a wave from the snack bar, a note pointing toward the library — all catch my eye at once.*

lunch_start_4.name: {name}
lunch_start_4.text: *At the end of the hallway, Seoyeon catches my eye and gestures. Pointing toward the rooftop.*

lunch_start_5.name: Dain
lunch_start_5.text: Hey! Eaten yet?! Let's hit the store! Loser buys bread!

lunch_start_6.name: {name}
lunch_start_6.text: *And Yuna slips out of the classroom with just her bag. Heading toward the library.*

lunch_start_7.name: {name}
lunch_start_7.text: *The hallway splits three ways. Rooftop, snack bar, library. Inside my pocket, the corner of my phone catches on my fingertips.*

lunch_choice.name: {name}
choices: Go to the school store with Dain

lunch_seo_1.name: {name}
lunch_seo_1.text: *Seoyeon unlocks the rooftop door with her key. A gust of wind rushes in.*

lunch_seo_2.name: {name}
lunch_seo_2.text: *The rooftop is clean. Each planter still glistens with water, and the folding chairs are propped against the wall at even intervals.*

lunch_seo_4.name: {name}
lunch_seo_4.text: The president gets her own rooftop?

lunch_seo_5.name: Seoyeon
lunch_seo_5.text: I don't just bring anyone up here. *unfolds a chair* Consider today an exception.

lunch_seo_6.name: {name}
lunch_seo_6.text: VIP treatment on day one? Now I'm suspicious.

lunch_seo_8.name: {name}
lunch_seo_8.text: *Seoyeon pulls out a lunchbox from her bag. Neatly packed for two.*

lunch_seo_10.name: Seoyeon
lunch_seo_10.text: I always pack extra. Council work keeps me busy, so I never know when I'll actually get to eat.

lunch_seo_11.name: {name}
lunch_seo_11.text: *She'd planned to share from the start. I open the lunchbox — rolled omelette, sausage, mini rice balls. Everything looks homemade.*

lunch_seo_14.name: Seoyeon
lunch_seo_14.text: A council president who can't even pack a lunch? Come on.

lunch_seo_16.name: Seoyeon
lunch_seo_16.text: *hands me chopsticks* Eat. It's not as good cold.

lunch_seo_17.name: {name}
lunch_seo_17.text: *Seoyeon eats instead of answering. The wind is nice. The school seen from the rooftop is bigger than you think.*

lunch_seo_21.name: Seoyeon
lunch_seo_21.text: *smirks* I asked about the school, and you answer about the food.

lunch_seo_22.name: {name}
lunch_seo_22.text: *Seoyeon picks up a piece of rolled omelette and holds it out.*

lunch_seo_choice.name: {name}
lunch_seo_choice.text: *Seoyeon is holding out the rolled omelette.*
choices: It'd taste better if you ate it yourself

lunch_seo_c1_1.name: {name}
lunch_seo_c1_1.text: *I take the rolled omelette from Seoyeon's chopsticks.*

lunch_seo_c2_1.name: {name}
lunch_seo_c2_1.text: *Seoyeon pops the rolled omelette into her mouth. Chewing slowly.*

lunch_seo_c2_3.name: {name}
lunch_seo_c2_3.text: *Seoyeon closes the lunchbox lid very slowly. Her pinky presses the edge of the lid one extra time.*

lunch_seo_after_2.name: Seoyeon
lunch_seo_after_2.text: Keep your lunch hour open next time, too.

lunch_seo_after_5.name: {name}
lunch_seo_after_5.text: *Not invited. Permitted. As Seoyeon packs up the lunchbox, she tucks her hair back with her pinky.*

lunch_seo_after_7.name: {name}
lunch_seo_after_7.text: *Seoyeon's pinky brushes the ends of her hair one more time.*

lunch_dain_1.name: Dain
lunch_dain_1.text: Here we are! Snack bar. Pick something!

lunch_dain_1_aff_default.name: Dain
lunch_dain_1_aff_default.text: *The snack bar's packed at lunch. The smell of bread and milk all mixed together.*

lunch_dain_2.name: Dain
lunch_dain_2.text: Soboro bread and strawberry milk. This combo's never failed me.

lunch_dain_3.name: {name}
lunch_dain_3.text: Hold on, you said loser buys. What's the game?

lunch_dain_14.name: {name}
lunch_dain_14.text: *Dain grumbles while buying the bread. But the corners of her mouth are turned up.*

lunch_dain_15.name: {name}
lunch_dain_15.text: *We sit on a bench by the school store and eat our bread.*

lunch_dain_16.name: Dain
lunch_dain_16.text: *tearing into bread* Hey, do you seriously not do sports?

lunch_dain_18.name: Dain
lunch_dain_18.text: Nah, hanging with me means a fitness test first lol

lunch_dain_19.name: {name}
lunch_dain_19.text: Thought this was about your PR.

lunch_dain_21.name: {name}
lunch_dain_21.text: Personal Record. It's a sports term.

lunch_dain_23.name: Dain
lunch_dain_23.text: Oh, you know that?! So you DO know sports!

lunch_dain_choice.name: {name}
lunch_dain_choice.text: *Dain is staring at me with expectant eyes.*
choices: A little. Would you teach me?

lunch_dain_c1_1.name: Dain
lunch_dain_c1_1.text: Good. Special training starts today. Gym after school, warm-ups first. Deal?

lunch_dain_c1_2.name: {name}
lunch_dain_c1_2.text: *Her eyes curve into half-moons. — I don't stand a chance against that smile.*

lunch_dain_c2_1.name: Dain
lunch_dain_c2_1.text: Come on, you're at least curious, right?! Drop by the gym after school! You won't regret it!

lunch_dain_after.name: {name}
lunch_dain_after.text: *We finish the bread and stand up.*

lunch_dain_after_4.name: Dain
lunch_dain_after_4.text: Your first meal at the new school, and it's with me? That's a record. RECORD!

lunch_dain_after_5.name: {name}
lunch_dain_after_5.text: *She grins and bumps my shoulder with her fist. She said it with such conviction, I just nodded.*

lunch_yuna_1.name: {name}
lunch_yuna_1.text: *I follow Yuna's silhouette into the library. The lunch bell rang a while ago, yet only the checkout desk chair sits empty, tilted at an odd angle.*

lunch_yuna_1_aff_default.name: Yuna
lunch_yuna_1_aff_default.text: *"..." She just sits down. No note this time.*

lunch_yuna_2.name: {name}
lunch_yuna_2.text: *Yuna takes a seat in the far corner of the reading room. She opens her book. When the legs of the chair across from her scrape faintly against the floor, her fingers freeze on the page.*

lunch_yuna_7.name: Yuna
lunch_yuna_7.text: *without looking up from her book* ...As long as you're quiet.

lunch_yuna_8.name: {name}
lunch_yuna_8.text: *Yuna reopens her book. She pushes the bag on the opposite chair under the desk. I take the empty seat.*

lunch_yuna_10.name: {name}
lunch_yuna_10.text: *Sitting in a library at lunch without saying a single word — and somehow it doesn't feel awkward. If anything, it's kind of nice.*

lunch_yuna_15.name: {name}
lunch_yuna_15.text: *She slides a book from beside her toward me.*

lunch_yuna_18.name: {name}
lunch_yuna_18.text: *Her sentences are short. Not cold — more like she's careful with them. I start reading. It's actually pretty good.*

lunch_yuna_22.name: Yuna
lunch_yuna_22.text: *sliding in a bookmark* ...Thanks for being quiet.

lunch_yuna_25.name: {name}
lunch_yuna_25.text: *Yuna stands up first and walks away. She doesn't look back. 'That was nice.' Those words alone stay behind on the desk.*

lunch_seo_freetalk.name: Seoyeon
lunch_seo_freetalk.text: *Sitting side by side with Seoyeon on the rooftop. The breeze feels nice.*
lunch_seo_freetalk.context: First day lunch, just finished eating Seoyeon's homemade bento on the rooftop. Still getting to know each other. Tone: Bright and light conversation. First-day excitement and curiosity. Never bring up heavy topics. Focus on banter and playful exchanges.
lunch_seo_freetalk.personality: Seoyeon is the cool-beauty student council president. Composed, witty, and direct. Shows interest through actions, not words.

lunch_dain_freetalk.name: Dain
lunch_dain_freetalk.text: *Sitting on a bench with Dain at the school store, eating bread.*
lunch_dain_freetalk.context: First day lunch, just had a rock-paper-scissors bet with Dain at the store. She lost and bought bread. Tone: Bright and light conversation. First-day excitement and curiosity. Never bring up heavy topics. Focus on banter and playful exchanges.
lunch_dain_freetalk.personality: Dain is an energetic athlete type. Loves physical contact, uses lots of exclamation marks. Tough outside, soft inside.

lunch_yuna_freetalk.name: Yuna
lunch_yuna_freetalk.text: *Reading books side by side with Yuna in the library. It's quiet, but comfortable.*
lunch_yuna_freetalk.context: First day lunch, just spent time with Yuna in the library. The quiet was nice. Tone: Bright and light conversation. First-day excitement and curiosity. Never bring up heavy topics. Focus on banter and playful exchanges.
lunch_yuna_freetalk.personality: Yuna is a mysterious literary girl. Short, dry sentences, but when she opens up, her sentences get longer. Communicates through notes.

lunch_seo_1_aff_high.name: Seoyeon
lunch_seo_1_aff_high.text: Sit. That line you pulled in the hallway earlier — kind of funny.

lunch_yuna_choice.name: {name}
lunch_yuna_choice.text: *The book Yuna left behind catches my eye. — She couldn't have gone far. I go after her.*
choices: Is that book good? Should I read it too?

lunch_yuna_c1_1.name: Yuna
lunch_yuna_c1_1.text: ...This? Yeah, it's good. Want to borrow it?

lunch_yuna_c1_2.name: Yuna
lunch_yuna_c1_2.text: ...When you're done, tell me what you thought. I'm curious.

lunch_yuna_c2_2.name: Yuna
lunch_yuna_c2_2.text: ...This library's not bad, though. It's quiet.

lunch_start_4_b.name: {name}
lunch_start_4_b.text: *Dain grabs my arm from the side.*

lunch_seo_6_b.name: Seoyeon
lunch_seo_6_b.text: *Smiling.* You're suspicious. — It's quiet up here.

lunch_seo_c1_2_b.name: {name}
lunch_seo_c1_2_b.text: *Seoyeon turns her head and absently fiddles with her water bottle.*

lunch_seo_c1_3_b.name: {name}
lunch_seo_c1_3_b.text: *The water bottle label rotates at your fingertips. Pretend you don’t know and raise your chopsticks.*

lunch_dain_12_b.name: Dain
lunch_dain_12_b.text: Ugh, fine! I'll buy, I'll buy! Two crumble buns, please!

lunch_yuna_10_b.name: {name}
lunch_yuna_10_b.text: *There is an old bookmark on Yuna's desk. The writing is hard to see. Yuna puts her hand on it. I take out a random book from a nearby shelf.*
